usage: The word 基因 (gene) is used as a noun in Cantonese.
基因 can refer to the units of heredity in biology.
It can be used in both scientific and everyday contexts when talking about inherited traits.
You can use 基因 to talk about characteristics passed from parents to children.
It is often combined with other scientific terms to describe genetic concepts.

examples.sentence: 人嘅基因決定咗佢嘅眼睛顏色。
